chunks: Those who believe and were God-conscious.
ai.seo_question: What are the two main characteristics of the righteous mentioned in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as establishing a causal link where true faith (iman) naturally cultivates God-consciousness (taqwa), reflecting the Ahl al-Bayt's emphasis on the unity of belief and practice. It underscores that the righteous are not merely believers in theory but are distinguished by their consistent mindfulness of God in all affairs, a trait highly valued in the concept of 'Ahl al-Qalb' (People of the Heart).
